description: Get one listing's profile: the company's description, website, sector and industry, SEC CIK, LEI and fiscal year end, the security's ISIN, type, market cap and shares outstanding, and the company's other listings on every covered exchange with the symbol each is read by. A retired ticker answers for the company that retired it, marked delisted. Pass a bare ticker for a US listing or MIC:TICKER (e.g. XETR:SIE) for one on another exchange; find a company by name with SearchListings.

ticker.description: Ticker (e.g. AAPL, BRK-B) or MIC:TICKER for a listing on another exchange (e.g. XETR:SIE).
